parameters.query:
-- Context for the checks that need history. Always returns one row (empty when nothing found).
-- References shorter than 6 characters are too generic to compare and are ignored.
with refs as (
  select nullif($2, '') as declared, nullif($3, '') as printed, nullif($4, '') as file_sha256
),
o as (
  select id, payment_method_id from public.orders where id = $1::uuid
)
select
  (select string_agg(concat_ws(' ', b->>'content_es', b->>'content_en'), ' ')
   from o
   join public.seller_payment_methods m on m.id = o.payment_method_id
   cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(m.display_blocks) b
   where b->>'type' = 'text') as method_text,
  coalesce((
    select json_agg(json_build_object('id', x.id, 'status', x.payment_status) order by x.created_at)
    from public.orders x, refs
    where x.id <> $1::uuid
      and (x.id in (
             select c.order_id from public.integration_receipt_checks c
             where c.transfer_ref_norm in (refs.declared, refs.printed) and length(c.transfer_ref_norm) >= 6)
           or (length(upper(regexp_replace(x.transfer_number, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g'))) >= 6
               and upper(regexp_replace(x.transfer_number, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) in (refs.declared, refs.printed)))
  ), '[]') as reused_reference,
  coalesce((
    select json_agg(distinct c.order_id)
    from public.integration_receipt_checks c, refs
    where c.order_id <> $1::uuid and c.file_sha256 = refs.file_sha256
  ), '[]') as reused_file;
